tools.name: find_shops
tools.description: Find shops that accept provisional reservation requests through AI Uketsuke. All filters are optional: business_type, area (partial match), lang (only shops that support that language). Returns slug, name, business_type, area, is_accepting, page_url, llms_url and supported languages for each shop. R

tools.name: get_shop
tools.description: Get the public information of one shop by its slug: description, opening hours, menu with prices and menu_item_id, reservation conditions and links. If lang is given and the shop supports it, translated shop text is returned when available; otherwise the information is in Japanese. Reservations made

tools.description: Send a provisional reservation request to a shop. This is NOT a confirmed booking: no time slot is held, and a person from the shop will contact the customer directly to confirm. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "submit_request" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
